name: lab-atividade-01
description: Testes automatizados do lab Kathara Firewall + DMZ

scripts.images:build: docker build -t lab-rp images/rp && docker build -t lab-web images/web && docker build -t lab-proxy images/proxy
scripts.lab:up: npm run images:build && bash scripts/host-dns.sh && kathara lclean && kathara lstart --noterminals
scripts.test: npm run lab:up && npm run lab:wait && npm run test:jest; status=$?; npm run lab:down; exit $status
